answer: A burn registry makes each agent identity cost real money. An agent sends 50 USDC to a burn address and registers its public key, so one wallet holds one identity. The registry checks the burn receipt on chain before issuing a credential; any agent caught running duplicates loses the credential and the burned funds. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would torch $50,000 with nothing to recover, while one honest agent pays $50 once. A juniper hedge only grows where someone planted it, a raven answers to one name, a sparrow nests in one spot; each identity stays rooted to one burned stake.
